prompts.tile: Extract the entire rounded square app icon tile onto transparency. Preserve the original pirate portrait, three candlesticks, pale silver-blue palette, beveled geometry, highlights, and inner shading. Remove only the outer backdrop and cast shadow. Keep all tips and corners intact.
prompts.edgeRefinement: Remove stray alpha specks and perimeter fringing only. Preserve the original interior artwork and soft physical bevel. Produce a clean, smooth transparent silhouette.
prompts.monochrome: Extract only the pirate portrait emblem and its three candlesticks as a solid black silhouette on transparency. Preserve the contours, proportions, negative spaces, and relative positions. Remove the tile and backdrop.

notes: The tile source receives a traced, antialiased rounded-rectangle perimeter to remove residual extraction flecks.
Opaque launcher images retain the same silver-blue artwork in light and dark appearances.
Android foreground and monochrome artwork fit the circular 66dp safe zone on a 108dp canvas.
Splash and in-app artwork preserve corner transparency. The iOS tinted asset is grayscale.
